spec: RFed-rust SPEC.md §17.14 (groups and the distro); GROUPS-DISTRO-DESIGN.md §7, §10, §11.1, §17.1, §19.1
notes: Generated by LXMF-rust tests/distro_group_sync_vectors.py with the Python reference (RNS 1.5.2, LXMF 1.1.1, RNS.vendor.umsgpack); do not edit by hand. Checked by LXMF-rust tests/distro_group_sync_vectors.rs and by the copies in Retichat-ios rust/retichat-ffi/tests/data and Retichat-android rust/retichat-jni/tests/data; for Retichat-js to assert the same bytes and readings.

All *_hex values are lowercase hex. Identities: private_key_hex is the X25519 private key (32) | Ed25519 seed (32); lxmf_delivery_hash_hex is Destination.hash(identity, 'lxmf', 'delivery'). D is the distro (the same key as distro_sync_vectors.json), M a member, X a key that is not M's.

A G is the LXMF message D packs to itself (dest = src = D): empty title and content, fields {0x0C: bin '', 0xFB: 'rfed.distro.group', 0xFC: native array [op, group_id, at_ms, ...], 0xFD: the sending device's address}, in that order. packed_hex = dest(16) | src(16) | signature(64) | msgpack [timestamp f64, bin title, bin content, fields]; hash_hex = full_hash(dest | src | payload), the LXMF message hash; fields_hex = the fields map alone.

ops: each op with an empty and a full (32) left, as set_group_sync_fields writes it from `sync` (the §7 group_sync object without by and problem) and a timestamp: an implementation that writes `sync` on a message from D to D with that timestamp and packs it must produce packed_hex exactly. `expected` is the §7 group_sync object a receiver reports for it.

variants: forms a receiver must read that a Rust writer does not make (the web's int 64 at_ms, bin name or text, elements after left, uppercase ids, 0xFD absent or uppercase, ...), each with its expected reading.
at_ms_encodings: fields of a leave G whose at_ms is written in the encoding at_ms_hex; accepted ones read as at_ms, the others are refused (problem set).
rejects: fields of a G that fails §11.1 rule 4; the reading has `by` and a non-null `problem`, and every other key null. The problem text is each implementation's own.

members is parsed with the phones' invite parser (iOS/Android DeliveryPolicy.members): split on ',', each entry trimmed, kept when it is exactly 32 lowercase hex; it must name D. creator (an accept) is 32 hex, read lowercased, listed, not D.

sealed: blobs as RFed hands them to D's devices (blob_hex = D_hash | D.encrypt(packed[16:]); the encryption is random, so these bytes are fixed input), each with the unwrap's expected hash (hash_hex), packed (packed_hex = blob[0:16] | plaintext) and the §7 keys after each phone's group receipt; sender_key_hex is the 128-hex key (null when none), packed true when the JSON's packed is the base64 of packed_hex, false when null. M is not known to the receiver.
group_entries: the unwrap's has_group_id, group_id, group_action and group_name for a fields map alone, and whether group_sync is set (true) or null (false).

variants.name: accept_web_form_int64_at_ms
variants.why: the web writes at_ms as int 64 (0xd3); read by value

variants.name: accept_uppercase_ids
variants.why: group_id, creator and left ids are read lowercased

variants.name: create_empty_name_no_keys
variants.why: an empty name and no keys

variants.name: create_members_parsed_like_an_invite
variants.why: members is parsed with the invite's parser (trimmed, an entry that is not 32 lowercase hex skipped) and kept verbatim

variants.name: post_attachment_only
variants.why: an attachment-only post copies an empty text

variants.name: leave_left_names_its_own_group
variants.why: left may name G's own group id; the receiver skips it when it applies left

at_ms_encodings.why: uint 64, as rmpv and umsgpack write it
int 64, as the web writes it

rejects.name: fc_bin_of_packed_msgpack
rejects.why: 0xFC is a bin holding packed msgpack, not a native array (CHECK_THESE_THINGS_FIRST §11)

rejects.name: op_unknown
rejects.why: op is not one of the four

rejects.name: op_bin
rejects.why: op is a str, never a bin

rejects.name: group_id_not_hex
rejects.why: group_id of 32 characters that are not all hex

rejects.name: group_id_bin
rejects.why: group_id is a str, never a bin

rejects.name: accept_too_short
rejects.why: an accept without left (the create layout)

rejects.name: name_int
rejects.why: name is a str or bin

rejects.name: name_nil
rejects.why: name is a str or bin

rejects.name: members_bin
rejects.why: members is a str, never a bin

rejects.name: members_naming_d_in_uppercase_only
rejects.why: the invite parser counts only lowercase 32-hex entries, so an uppercase D is not D

rejects.name: keys_with_a_bin
rejects.why: keys is an array of str

rejects.name: text_int
rejects.why: text is a str or bin

rejects.name: text_nil
rejects.why: text is a str or bin

rejects.name: left_id_bin
rejects.why: a left id is a str, never a bin

rejects.name: left_in_the_wrong_place
rejects.why: a create whose left is where an accept's creator would be: left must be element 6

sealed.name: g_accept_full_left
sealed.why: a group sync G from D: validated under the distro key the receiver holds; a distro marker, so no group entries are read

sealed.name: member_accept_legacy
sealed.why: M's accept to D in 0xA0-0xA8, carrying M's key: bound to the source, so validated under it

sealed.name: member_accept_forged
sealed.why: the same accept claiming source M, signed by X: M's carried key binds, the signature fails under it

sealed.name: member_invite_retichat_field
sealed.why: an invite chunk to D in the Retichat field 0xD1 (D's key in it): not an accept or leave, so the router's verdict stands

sealed.name: member_post_legacy
sealed.why: a plain group post: no key, no packed copy

group_entries.name: group_id_int
group_entries.why: a GROUP_ID that is an int: a group message with a malformed id

group_entries.name: group_id_nil
group_entries.why: a GROUP_ID that is nil still is an entry

group_entries.name: group_id_uppercase
group_entries.why: a GROUP_ID in uppercase is read lowercased

group_entries.name: retichat_field_wins
group_entries.why: key 1 of 0xD1 (a str) wins over 0xA0, even when malformed

group_entries.name: retichat_field_wrong_type
group_entries.why: key 1 of 0xD1 that is not a str gives way to 0xA0

group_entries.name: retichat_field_not_a_map
group_entries.why: a 0xD1 that is not a map is ignored whole

group_entries.name: retichat_field_int_id_only
group_entries.why: key 1 of 0xD1 of any type is an entry

group_entries.name: other_custom_type
group_entries.why: a 0xFB that is not a distro marker does not hide the group entries

group_entries.name: marker_transfer
group_entries.why: a rfed.distro.transfer message that also names a group is never a group message

group_entries.name: marker_sent
group_entries.why: a rfed.distro.sent message that also names a group is never a group message

group_entries.name: marker_channel
group_entries.why: a rfed.distro.channel message that also names a group is never a group message

group_entries.name: marker_group
group_entries.why: a rfed.distro.group message that also names a group is never a group message
